title: Natural Code Transformation Confuses Agents in Vulnerability Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2610.14350v2 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Having demonstrated a strong potential for automating vulnerability discovery, AI agents can also be used to attack software systems at scale. Today's software systems need mechanisms to level the playing field by slowing down potential attacks, giving them time to patch vulnerabilities and strengthen software. Along this line, our study of agent trajectories in vulnerability analysis shows a surprising finding: agents produce dramatically different results across real-world code commits that carry the same functionality and the same vulnerability. This phenomenon appears consistently in multiple code domains and vulnerability categories.   It motivates us to study natural and functionality-preserving code transformations derived from real-world software development, and their potential as a defense against attacker agents. We build a corpus of natural transformations by mining recurring development patterns from real-world code commit

translated_title: 自然代码变换使智能体在漏洞分析中产生混淆
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.14350v2 公告类型： cross 摘要：在展示了自动化漏洞发现的强大潜力之后，AI智能体也可以被用来大规模攻击软件系统。当今的软件系统需要一些机制来平衡攻防双方的力量，通过减缓潜在攻击的速度，为防御者争取时间来修补漏洞并强化软件。沿着这一思路，我们对漏洞分析中智能体行为轨迹的研究揭示了一个令人惊讶的发现：对于承载相同功能和相同漏洞的真实世界代码提交，智能体产生了截然不同的分析结果。这一现象在多个代码领域和漏洞类别中持续出现。这促使我们研究源自真实世界软件开发过程的自然且保持功能不变的代码变换，以及其作为防御攻击者智能体的潜力。我们通过从真实世界代码提交中挖掘反复出现的开发模式，构建了一个自然变换语料库。
tldr: 本文发现AI智能体在分析具有相同功能和相同漏洞的不同真实代码提交时会产出截然不同的结果，并据此提出从真实开发模式中挖掘自然且功能保持的代码变换，作为防御攻击者智能体的新手段。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that AI agents produce dramatically different vulnerability analysis results on real-world code commits carrying identical functionality and vulnerabilities, and proposes mining natural, functionality-preserving code transformations from real-world development patterns as a defense against attacker agents.
